1. We were snowed in. We couldn't even open the front door.
2. We were flooded out. All our carpets were ruined.
3. The rain didn't let up. We ate our picnic in the car.
4. It cleared up later on. We went for a walk in the evening.

6. The match was rained off. The teams were very disappointed.
